contentItem.title: 直角所夹两线构成的矩形
contentItem.englishTitle: Any rectangular parallelogram is said to be contained by the two straight lines containing the right angle.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: Any rectangular parallelogram is said to be contained by the two straight lines containing the right angle.
据说,任何矩形平行四边形由含有直角的两条直线组成。
